places.name: Masjid al-Haram (Grand Mosque)
places.ai_summary: The largest mosque in the world, surrounding Islam's holiest site, the Kaaba, and accommodating millions of pilgrims annually.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable footwear as the mosque is vast.

places.name: Kaaba
places.ai_summary: The most sacred site in Islam, located within the Masjid al-Haram, towards which all Muslims pray.
places.place_tip: Maintain a respectful demeanor as this is a religious site.

attribution.title: Adriaan-Reland-Verhandeling-van-de-godsdienst-der-Mahometaanen MG 0723
attribution.author: drawing: Jan Goeree
attribution.description: "Templum Meccanum. Sanctissimum apud Mohamedanos, et vetustissima religione consecratum". Temple in Mecca with detailed explanations A-Q. ..Kaaba..

places.name: Abraj Al Bait Clock Tower
places.ai_summary: A part of the Abraj Al Bait complex, this clock tower is one of the tallest buildings in the world and features a large clock face.

opening_hours.notes: The viewing deck has separate hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the viewing deck for a panoramic view of Mecca.

attribution.title: Black Stone front and side
attribution.credit: William Muir: "The Life of Mahomet from original sources". London: Smith, Elder & Co. 1894. p. 27.
attribution.description: "The Black Stone, front and side views" (original caption)

places.name: Mount Arafat (Jabal al-Rahma)
places.ai_summary: An important site for Hajj pilgrims, it's the place where Prophet Muhammad delivered his farewell sermon.
places.place_tip: Bring water and wear comfortable shoes.

attribution.title: Arafat pilgrims
attribution.author: Karim Manji
attribution.description: Pilgrims supplicating on the Plains of Arafat on the Day of Arafat

places.name: Jabal al-Nour (Cave of Hira)
places.ai_summary: The mountain where Prophet Muhammad received the first revelation from Angel Gabriel.
places.place_tip: Dress modestly and be respectful.

places.name: Zamzam Well
places.ai_summary: A sacred well located within the Masjid al-Haram, believed to be a miraculously generated source of water.
places.place_tip: Drink plenty of water, especially after the Tawaf.

places.name: Mina Tent City
places.ai_summary: A city of tents where pilgrims stay during the Hajj, symbolizing the unity of Muslims worldwide.
places.place_tip: Experience the communal prayers and activities.

places.name: Masjid al-Taneem (Aisha Mosque)
places.ai_summary: A mosque located outside the city of Mecca, it's a popular place for pilgrims to enter the state of Ihram.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trip to the nearby Uhud Mountain.

attribution.title: Flag of France

attribution.credit: This SVG flag includes elements that have been taken or adapted from this flag:

places.name: Makkah Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history and culture of Mecca, including artifacts and exhibits related to the Hajj.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the section on the history of the Kaaba.

places.name: Mount Thawr (Cave of Thawr)
places.ai_summary: The cave where Prophet Muhammad and Abu Bakr hid from their pursuers before migrating to Medina.
places.place_tip: Bring water and wear comfortable shoes.

places.name: Hira Cultural Center
places.ai_summary: A cultural center offering insights into the history of Islam and the life of Prophet Muhammad.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for a more in-depth understanding.

places.name: Al Jamarat Bridge
places.ai_summary: A bridge in Mina where pilgrims perform the ritual of stoning the devil during Hajj.
places.place_tip: Participate in the stoning ritual if you're visiting during Hajj.

places.name: Abraj Al Bait Mall
places.ai_summary: A large shopping mall in Mecca, offering a variety of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options.
places.place_tip: Visit the food court for a variety of dining options.

places.name: Kaaki Palace Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum located in a historic palace, showcasing Islamic art and artifacts.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the art gallery on the top floor.

places.name: Makkah Mall
places.ai_summary: A modern shopping mall in Mecca, featuring a wide range of international brands and dining options.
places.place_tip: Visit the entertainment center for family-friendly activities.

places.name: Masjid Al-Jinn
places.ai_summary: A mosque with unique architecture, located near the cave where Prophet Muhammad is said to have met with the Jinn.
places.place_tip: Explore the area around the mosque for other historical sites.

places.ai_summary: A historical site with a courtyard believed to be associated with Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham).
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the nearby Masjid Al-Jinn.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.ai_summary: A mosque named after Bilal ibn Rabah, the Prophet's muezzin, located in the heart of Mecca.
places.place_tip: Visit the nearby historical sites.

places.name: Islamic Heritage Route Tour
places.ai_summary: A guided tour that takes you through the historical and religious sites of Mecca, including the birthplace of Prophet Muhammad.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothing and shoes.
